key_insight: KnottedGraph unifies graph connectivity and spatial embedding into a scalable knotted-graph representation so scientific structures can be topologically classified and analyzed with knot invariants.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical computational pipeline for topology-aware analysis of complex scientific data, with potential use in geometry processing, network science, and AI-assisted mathematical discovery.
method: Converts scientific objects into knotted graphs with projected diagrams and PD codes.
Computes topological invariants, including Yamada-polynomial evaluations, for branching graph-like structures.
Uses partial resolutions with shared unresolved connections and optimized processing order to scale exact computation.
evidence_signal: The method was verified against published invariants on knotted graphs with up to 500 crossings and used to derive candidate closed-form Yamada polynomials for graph motif families.
watch_item: Exact evaluation remains computationally demanding for highly complex embeddings, so performance and robustness may depend on diagram construction and resolution ordering.
paper_title: KnottedGraph: Scalable knotted-graph topology for scientific and mathematical discovery
